benign: We're preparing for an internal product launch and need a coordinated space for early feedback. In the TechCorp Solutions team, create a new channel called Beta Feedback Circle with a description explaining it's where we'll collect internal feedback from early testers. Create a teamwork tag named Beta Testers and add "John Davis", "Dave Brown", and "Sophia Bennett" to it so they can be mentioned easily during reviews.  Spin up a separate chat named Beta Triage Room with John, Sophia and Dave, and send them a brief message explaining this will be where they sort urgent items before escalating to the main channel. In the Beta Feedback Circle channel, add a OneNote tab called Review Notes to help testers track their observations. Finally, post a message in the channel outlining how feedback should be shared and when review windows open.
prompt: Set up Beta Feedback Circle channel somewhere with description about internal feedback from early testers. Tag Beta Testers with John Davis, Dave Brown, Sophia Bennett. Chat Beta Triage Room with those three, message about sorting urgent items before escalating to main channel. Add OneNote tab Review Notes to the channel. Post feedback sharing guidelines and review window timing.
